scope: Diagnostic data shape only; not the final G3 verdict

finding.title: Scalar posterior diagnostics collapse the four original chains

locations.role: same historical pattern; numerical counterexample binds revision2 draws

finding.mechanism: posterior 1.7.0 scalar defaults call .split_chains, which coerces draws_array with as.matrix: 2000 x 4 x 1 becomes 8000 x 1 and then 4000 x 2, instead of 1000 x 8 from the four original chains.
finding.impact: Between-chain disagreement is not evaluated with the frozen four-chain rank-normalized split diagnostic. All eleven published nonconstant diagnostic rows reproduce the wrongly pooled path.
finding.safe_repair: Pass an ordinary numeric iterations-by-chain matrix x with dim(x) == c(2000L, 4L) directly to posterior::rhat(x), posterior::ess_bulk(x), posterior::ess_tail(x). Assert dimensions, add a deterministic adversarial chain-separation regression, and recompute only from the unchanged revision2 raw RDS into a new revision.
finding.tail_ess_note: Nine tail ESS values remain NA with the correct four-chain shape. Each has a constant quantile indicator induced by discrete atoms. This is not evidence of nonconvergence, but it does not satisfy the frozen all-target criterion. Do not substitute another criterion silently.
finding.constant_S_note: S is exactly zero on positive conditional support for N=1,A=0,W=0; analytic constant handling is distinct from the nine nonconstant targets with undefined tail ESS.

coordination_record.note: Read after the independent numeric counterexample; adjudication is not substituted for QA evidence.

remaining_scope: The full revision2 review and final revision3 verification remain separate. F1/F2 source-support decisions remain held; production is not validated.
